purpose: Reduce a selected object to one lawful bounded move, observed consequence, durable evidence and exact re-entry without creating a new authority plane.
laws: One object/focus at a time unless the native host explicitly defines a composite object.
HOLD is selection/focus and creates no effect authority.
At most three candidate native moves may be exposed at HOLD.
TURN executes exactly one bounded native move.
If TURN crosses an EFFECT boundary, RELEASE/commit must be explicit and host-native.
TRACE separates observed, derived and unknown claims.
RETURN is required for changed, unchanged, failed, blocked and unknown outcomes.
RETURN never auto-authorizes NEXT; replan from CURRENT after closure.
Authority may stay equal or decrease across projection/handoff; it may not silently increase.
No second move inherits authority from the first.

exit: action-relevant ambiguity resolved or marked UNKNOWN

example.result: stale system map identified from exact current files

exit: one move may be deliberately selected
fail_closed: scope silently expands to several objects

example.desired_delta: current truthful architecture map reachable from FIELD without enlarging primary surface

example.result: map + latent link + manifest + receipt written; no new dashboard/store

exit: what changed is distinguishable from what is merely inferred
fail_closed: behavioral claim supported only by intention/prose/image/model belief

example.observed_delta: committed files resolve requested architecture and route
unknowns: no attached CI run/live-render proof at trace time

exit: successor can resume without reconstructing intent/authority/evidence/gate

worker_rules: Prefer node tools/ship-check.mjs --fast plus the smallest feature-specific selftest.
Do not claim CI/browser/device/human/world proof unless it actually ran.
After RETURN re-read CURRENT before another consequential move.
If no lawful high-value move exists, emit NO_LAWFUL_HIGH_VALUE_MOVE and stop.

field_semantics.result_status: One status enum; receipt existence never implies success.
field_semantics.host: Native authority that owned the TURN.
field_semantics.turn_ref: Exact commit/effect/result identifier for the one TURN.
field_semantics.after: Observed post-TURN state; null only when unavailable and explained in unknowns.
field_semantics.evidence_refs: Exact evidence references supporting material claims.
field_semantics.unresolved_gate: Null or exact remaining human/device/world/policy gate.
field_semantics.return_address: Exact re-entry address for the same object/context.
field_semantics.next_authority: Always NONE at closure; a new move requires fresh SOURCE/HOLD.

stop_conditions.UNRESOLVED_SOURCE: Exact host/object/provenance cannot be resolved without consequence-changing ambiguity.
stop_conditions.WAITING_HUMAN_WORLD: An irreducible human/device/world property is required. Park it; do not occupy NOW.
stop_conditions.TURN_UNSUPPORTED: Native host does not support the requested move.
stop_conditions.TRACE_FAIL: Observed result violates a declared acceptance condition.
stop_conditions.TRACE_INDETERMINATE: Required evidence is unavailable; keep the claim UNKNOWN.
stop_conditions.NO_LAWFUL_HIGH_VALUE_MOVE: No bounded executable move directly advances the selected front; stop rather than forage.

evidence_requirements: Run machine-verifiable checks before asking for human/device/world confirmation.
Classify material TRACE claims as OBSERVED, DERIVED, or UNKNOWN.
PASS requires sufficient evidence for every declared acceptance condition.
FAIL preserves the violated condition and evidence.
INDETERMINATE preserves the missing capability/evidence; it is not PASS.
Do not claim CI/browser/device/human/world proof unless it actually ran.
coding_model_instruction: SOURCE: resolve one exact object + native owner + provenance + before-state + desired delta + return address. STOP UNRESOLVED_SOURCE if ambiguity would change the move.
HOLD: freeze one focus; expose at most 3 host-supported moves; select one TURN; predeclare acceptance checks, commit boundary, reversibility and RETURN address.
TURN: execute exactly one native operation. EFFECT requires explicit host-native RELEASE/commit. Do not start a second improvement.
TRACE: run machine-verifiable evidence first; classify claims OBSERVED/DERIVED/UNKNOWN and outcome PASS/FAIL/INDETERMINATE. Missing evidence never becomes PASS.
RETURN: always close CHANGED/UNCHANGED/FAILED/BLOCKED/UNKNOWN with every required RETURN field; set next_authority=NONE; release focus; re-read CURRENT before any new consequential move.

source.state_before: Stage gates existed, but exact RETURN field names and a single copyable coding-model block were not machine-declared.

hold.desired_delta: Add exact RETURN schema + compact coding-model instruction + one complete worked run without changing host authority or stage semantics.
candidate_moves: mirror exact block/worked run in human protocol
hold.selected_turn: one repository commit touching only those three protocol facets
acceptance_checks: exact RETURN required_fields match the 14-field schema
coding block includes <=3 HOLD, one TURN, tri-state evidence, stop conditions and next_authority=NONE
TURN commit touches only the three declared protocol facets
hold.reversibility: git revert of the single TURN commit

turn.native_operation: single Git commit over existing protocol files

required: re-fetch all three files from master after commit
re-run the selftest assertions against fetched JSON
inspect TURN commit diff and require only declared files
record CI/browser status separately; never claim absent checks
